description: For a helper session that is not in the call: appends one line (3-8 words) to the call's activity feed as 'Helper <label>: <helper_name>: <text>'. Never spoken verbatim. Returns the line.

credential.description: Helper credential `token` from helper_credential or POST /api/helper/credential.
credential.title: Credential

helper_name.description: Name of this helper session, 1-40 chars (shown on the call page as `from`).
helper_name.title: Helper Name

name: helper_activity
title: Helper: add an activity line
